title: Coherence of enriched evaluation with projective replacement
statement:
Use simplicial model categories and the homotopy coherent nerve $N_{\mathrm{hc}}$ of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization], small simplicial categories of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison], and coherent functor categories of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $\mathcal A$ be a simplicial model category, let $I$ be a small simplicial category, let $B$ be a locally Kan simplicial category (all its mapping simplicial sets are Kan), and let $H_0,H_1:B\to\operatorname{Fun}_{\Delta}(I,\mathcal A)$ be simplicial functors. The target is the simplicial category of enriched functors with the enriched-end mapping simplicial sets as in [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus]; no model structure on it is required. Assume every value $H_j(b)(i)$ is bifibrant. Let $q:H_0\Rightarrow H_1$ be a simplicially enriched natural transformation, meaning component vertices whose naturality equations hold as equalities of simplicial maps on all mapping objects, and assume every component $q_b(i)$ is a weak equivalence in $\mathcal A$. Fix a small simplicial set $K$ and any map $a:K\to N_{\mathrm{hc}}I$. Universes may be enlarged to contain $B$ and $\mathcal A$.

Enriched evaluation defines functors $e_j:B\times I\to\mathcal A^{cf}$ by $e_j(b,i)=H_j(b)(i)$. Take their coherent nerves, using $N_{\mathrm{hc}}(B\times I)=N_{\mathrm{hc}}B\times N_{\mathrm{hc}}I$, precompose in the second variable with $a$, and curry to obtain
$$E_j:N_{\mathrm{hc}}B\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}(K,N_{\mathrm{hc}}(\mathcal A^{cf})).$$
There is a coherent natural equivalence $E_0\Rightarrow E_1$ induced by enriched evaluation of $q$. Its component at $(b,k)$ is the edge corresponding to $q_b(a(k))$. More precisely, the enriched transformation $e_0\Rightarrow e_1$ with components $q_b(i)$ defines a simplicial functor $(B\times I)\times[1]\to\mathcal A^{cf}$, where $[1]$ has discrete mapping sets; its nerve, precomposed with $a$ and curried, is this natural equivalence. Here $a(k)$ denotes the object of $I$ corresponding to the vertex $a(k)$ of its nerve. No assumption that either $E_j$ is an equivalence is made.

source.place: Agent-extracted enriched evaluation/replacement comparison from returned item step 7, last paragraph. Supporting references: HTT Proposition 4.2.4.4 (evaluation comparison), Proposition 1.2.7.3 (vertex criterion), and Propositions A.3.3.7-A.3.3.8 (restriction), read online at the source document. No Stacks tag states this enriched coherence assertion; the independent two-parameter construction is in report.md.
